title: "Consulting & Portfolio"

I help organizations answer hard empirical questions. As a Political Science PhD researcher with a background in **quantitative methods, R, and GIS**, I work with think tanks, advocacy organizations, campaigns, and firms that need rigorous research design and clear, decision-ready analysis — from one-off statistical reviews to end-to-end research projects.

## Services

::: {.grid .service-grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### Quantitative research design
Causal inference strategy, survey and experimental design, power analysis, and pre-registration — designing studies that can actually answer your question.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### Statistical modeling in R
Regression and panel models, difference-in-differences, machine learning, and reproducible pipelines with documented, version-controlled code.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### Data visualization
Publication- and briefing-quality charts and maps (ggplot2, ArcGIS) that make quantitative results legible to non-technical audiences.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### GIS & spatial analysis
Geocoding, areal interpolation, spatial joins, and exposure measurement — turning messy geographic data into analysis-ready variables.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### Policy analysis
Literature synthesis, program evaluation, and policy memos grounded in evidence — with experience in climate and energy policy on two continents.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### Text analysis
Content analysis, document classification, and text-as-data methods for reports, media coverage, and open-ended survey responses.
:::

:::

## Selected portfolio

::: {.portfolio-card}
### Blackout exposure mapping at scale

[R · ArcGIS · areal interpolation · panel data]{.tools}

Built a district-level panel of electricity-outage exposure for the São Paulo metropolitan region by population-weighting data across 27,000+ census tracts, then produced publication-quality maps and trend visualizations of shortage exposure and its political consequences.

[View project →](#) <!-- placeholder link -->
:::

::: {.portfolio-card}
### Causal analysis of infrastructure and voting

[R · difference-in-differences · two-way fixed effects]{.tools}

Designed and estimated quasi-experimental models of how localized infrastructure shocks affect turnout and incumbent support, including heterogeneous-effects analysis for high-vulnerability communities and a spatially weighted identification strategy.

[View project →](#) <!-- placeholder link -->
:::

::: {.portfolio-card}
### Cross-national expert survey coordination

[survey design · stakeholder management · 50+ countries]{.tools}

Coordinated the advisory board and stakeholder communications for a cross-national climate expert survey spanning more than 50 countries, supporting instrument design, fieldwork logistics, and synthesis of findings into policy-facing memos.

[View project →](#) <!-- placeholder link -->
